stem:
The list shows the amount of flour in pounds used by a bakery each day for 15 days.

16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 23, 24, 29, 30, 31, 32, 32, 32, 32, 35
Which box plot best displays a summary of these data?

options.label: F
options.text: (box plot with minimum at 16, Q1 near 20, median near 29, Q3 near 31, maximum at 35)

options.label: G
options.text: (box plot with minimum at 15, Q1 near 20, median near 30, Q3 near 35, maximum at 35)

options.label: H
options.text: (box plot with minimum around 16, Q1 near 23, median near 29, Q3 near 32, maximum at 35)

options.label: J
options.text: (box plot with minimum at 16, two dots at 17 and 18, Q1 near 24, median near 29, Q3 near 32, maximum at 35)

notes: Options show box plots with labeled minimum, quartiles, median, and maximum on a scale from 15 to 35 pounds.
